plot: At 2 a.m. Mom's new robot vacuum starts its first night shift while Zeek is on the floor measuring it, the other bros slide down the dish towel to help and get cut off from their only way back up, Pim's slipper hide and angry Lolly's charge both get bumped, and Crispy steps in front to be eaten first — the twist: the robot backs away from him, because (as Zeek noticed at the black doormat at the start) its floor sensors read black as a hole; Crispy leads the bros like ducklings back to the towel, glad for once that something runs from him — then in the morning Mia's science-fair volcano won't erupt.

script.title: Mom's New Robot Vacuum Eats Crumbs

beats.say: It's awake! The robot is awake, and it's rolling at me!
Two a.m., right on time. Zeek, run to my corner!
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Last night Mom unboxed it. A round robot vacuum. It eats crumbs.
On the counter, Bup, Pim and Lolly wake in the basket.
I only came down to measure it. Thirty centimeters of pure hunger.
Strange data, though. It backed away from the black doormat. Twice.
The robot turns. It rolls straight at Zeek. Bump. Spin. Again.
Stay close to me. Things usually run away from me anyway.
Hang on, you two! We're coming down the towel!
They slide down the towel. Now all five are on the floor.
Why did we come DOWN? Down is where the robot lives!
Because family comes down. Now hush. It's listening.
The robot hums. It rolls a slow circle around the kitchen.
It can't see us. It bumps, turns, and tries a new direction.
We wait till it turns away. Then we run for it.
They run. The robot turns. It cuts them off from the towel.
It cleans for an hour. One bump, and we're inside it.
I'm hiding in Dad's slipper. Slippers are safe. Slippers are life.
Pim dives into Dad's slipper. The robot bumps the slipper. Pim screams.
It knocked! It knocked on my slipper!
Oh, that is IT. Nobody knocks on my brother's slipper!
Lolly marches at it. It bumps her. She spins like a coin.
Its brushes pull in anything small. Crumbs. Raisins. Cookies. Beans.
Then everyone behind me. If it eats anything, it eats the rock.
Crispy stands alone in the middle. The robot rolls at him.
Crispy, move! Please move! I'll miss your spooky voice!
The robot reaches Crispy. It stops. Beep. Then it backs away.
It ran from me. Even robots run from me.
Half an hour left. The robot circles back and parks there.
It's guarding our only way up! We'll be down here till morning!
And at seven, Dad walks in barefoot. Right through here.
Wait. Zeek. You said it backed away from the doormat.
Twice! The doormat is black. And you are... very black.
Robots have eyes underneath. Black looks like a hole. Stairs!
So it's not scared of me. It thinks I'm a hole.
You're not scary, Crispy. You're a very useful hole.
Everyone. Line up behind me. Close. Like ducklings.
Crispy walks first. Then Bup, Zeek, Lolly, and Pim in his slipper.
The robot rolls at them. It sees Crispy. Beep. It backs away.
Step by step, they reach the towel. One by one, they climb.
I'll go last. Holes always go last.
Crispy climbs. The robot bumps the towel. Then it rolls home.
For years things ran from me, and it hurt. Tonight it helped.
Tomorrow I'm drawing a black line around the bread basket.
In the morning, Mia drags a heavy clay volcano onto the table.
The school science fair is Friday. And her volcano won't erupt.
A volcano? In our kitchen? Who allowed this?
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

long.title: Mom's New Robot Vacuum Eats Crumbs 🤖 (Ep 32)
long.description:
What do you think happens in the next part? Tell me in the comments.
"Things always run away from me. Tonight, for once, it helped." — Crispy
At two a.m. Mom's new robot vacuum starts its first night shift — and five little crumbs are stuck on the kitchen floor between it and their only way back up.
